scope: Source-only review of four proposed inventory procedures. No browser, handler, build, test, release, or runtime execution occurred.

supported: String and numeric tab_id schema, explicit tab targeting, direct manual-run boundary, and the unresolved focus gate match source.
missing_or_incorrect: The fixture initializes #keys to 'seed'. The proposed positive call uses CDP Input.insertText, which inserts at the focused caret; source performs no select-all, clear, or replacement. Requiring the value exactly 'ext-f-4106-probe' is therefore unsupported and likely fails even with correct focus. A valid positive path must establish an empty field or selected contents and prove insertion-time focus before asserting an exact value.
The fixture is mounted only by a short-lived unit test; there is no repeatable manual host. Warm and reload positive paths remain unexecutable until one is supplied.
evidence: src/lib/tools/handlers/cdp.ts:370-394 Input.insertText without focus or replacement

supported: Read-tier canonical schema uses string tab_id, four conditions, target refinement, exact fixture selectors and heading, bounded timeout, and distinct schema rejection versus handler timeout. The duplicate legacy Action row warning is accurate.
missing_or_incorrect: No current manual fixture host exposes /form-controls, so positive branches are conditional rather than executable now. Permission dimension remains open because direct Run bypasses dispatch. The procedure must retain NOT_EXECUTABLE design status until a real host and receipt exist.

supported: Admin-only declaration, list/attach/detach schema, explicit numeric tab ID, baseline/delta ownership, repeated attach, exact-ID cleanup, and reload reacquisition follow the source behavior.
missing_or_incorrect: The claimed owned route cannot currently be opened through a standalone manual host, so positive execution is blocked. The list reports the extension worker's in-memory set; service-worker restart or idle detach can invalidate a baseline between steps. A run must treat such a change as inconclusive rather than a product failure. Direct Run cannot prove the admin or debugger gate.

supported: Set and clear schema, missing-field handler refusal, out-of-range width schema rejection, admin declaration, explicit tab targeting, and the host blocker match source.
missing_or_incorrect: Clear reports {ok:true} even if the tab is not attached. When attached it catches and discards a user-agent reset error. Therefore the procedure must not present {ok:true} as proof that viewport or UA was restored; it needs independent native readback and must keep cleanup unverified on mismatch. The host is absent, so runtime positives remain blocked.
The set path attaches to CDP and does not detach; the proposed exact-owned delta cleanup is necessary and must be measured before any detach.

verdict_a_procedural_usefulness.integration_ruling: The four rows can be integrated as explicitly conditional source proposals with design_status and runtime/permissions unverified. Before anyone executes them for acceptance, repair 4106's exact-value setup, qualify 4169's cleanup result, and supply an owned manual fixture host. No row is presently an executable positive acceptance procedure.

supported: The patch preserves inventory scope and mode applicability, separates schema invalidity from permission refusal, requires a receipt and real extension reload, avoids claiming runtime results, and protects pre-existing CDP attachments.
issues: 4106's exact-value oracle contradicts the fixture and insertText semantics; important because it can turn a working feature into a false failure.
4169's clear return is an insufficient cleanup oracle because UA reset failure is swallowed; important because the procedure could leave changed browser state while reporting success.
All four depend on an unimplemented manual fixture host, correctly disclosed but preventing immediate execution.
verdict_b_quality.runtime_unknown: No source review establishes current fixture availability, user focus at insertion time, native CDP effects, permission enforcement, role behavior, or warm/reloaded results.
